title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v9.02 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) D

ai_review.summary: A high‑quality soundboard capture of a mellow yet soaring 1973 show, highlighted by legendary renditions of Loose Lucy, Eyes of the World and Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The performance is repeatedly described as incredible, with a relaxed but powerful groove that showcases the band’s jazzy ’73‑’74 vibe. Standout numbers like Loose Lucy, They Love Each Other (fast), China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, Here Comes Sunshine, Let It Grow, Eyes of the World and a soaring Dark Star receive particular praise, while the soundboard source is noted as generally clear despite occasional wonky spots.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5 stars and note a strong musical performance with many standout songs; recording is praised as soundboard quality with only minor issues, yielding an overall excellent rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers commend the pleasant, clear soundboard capture; a few mention occasional wonky moments but no serious dropouts or distortion.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is praised for its consistent groove and relaxed pacing, typical of the band’s 1973‑74 jazzy period, with a particularly strong second set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is repeatedly lauded as sweet, perfect, and one of the best on record.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals are noted as slightly rough but his playing remains solid throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards are highlighted for their organic, harmonious sound that defines this era.
